resources.string: Warns you the moment a scam message or link is on your screen.

Sniff reads the text that is visible on your screen and in new notifications so it can warn you about scam messages and links (fake KYC, bank, parcel, electricity bill, prize and UPI collect scams). It skips password fields and banking/UPI apps. Each new message or link is checked by Sniff AI; the text is not stored on your phone or on a server. If a browser opens a dangerous site, Sniff can close it and take you somewhere safe.
Not sure about a message, link or number? Show me. I\'ll tell you if it\'s safe to click.
On. I\'m watching your messages, notifications and browser for scams.
Off. Turn it on and I\'ll warn you the moment a scam shows up on your screen.
If a browser opens a scam site, I\'ll close it and take you somewhere safe.

Sniff reads the text on your screen and in new notifications using Android\'s Accessibility setting. It never reads password fields and ignores banking and UPI apps. Each new message or link is checked by Sniff AI and is never stored.
Checked by Sniff AI. Your messages are never stored.

On the next screen, tap \"Sniff scam warnings\" (it may be under \"Installed apps\" or \"Downloaded apps\") and switch it on.\n\nSniff reads visible text only to spot scams. It skips passwords and banking/UPI apps, and stores nothing.
Shown when a scam message or link is on your screen
